en.headline: ICAC charges former SFC manager over unauthorised access to internal systems
en.dek: Tong Ka-lei, 39, faces 12 counts of obtaining computer access for dishonest gain after alleged searches of confidential case files and licensee data between 2020 and 2024.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption has charged a former manager of the Securities and Futures Commission with unauthorised access to the regulator’s internal information systems.

Tong Ka-lei, 39, who previously worked in the SFC’s enforcement division, faces 12 counts of obtaining access to a computer with a view to dishonest gain for herself or another, contrary to the Crimes Ordinance. She is scheduled to appear at Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Monday.

The ICAC said that between December 2020 and December 2024, Tong allegedly conducted 12 unauthorised searches targeting 10 individuals and commercial entities. At the time she was assigned to the corporate misconduct team, whose core duties involved investigating suspected fraud among listed companies. None of the searches related to her assigned cases, the watchdog said.
The ICAC and the SFC conducted a joint investigation. Tong was subsequently dismissed by the SFC. A related bribery investigation remains ongoing.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴證監會前經理涉不誠實取用內部資訊系統
zh.dek: 39歲唐嘉麗被控12項不誠實取用電腦罪名，涉嫌在2020至2024年間多次未經授權查閱機密個案及持牌人資料。
body: 廉政公署今日落案起訴一名證券及期貨事務監察委員會前經理，控告她涉嫌不誠實地取用證監會內部資訊系統。
現年39歲的唐嘉麗曾任職證監會執法部，被控12項「不誠實取用電腦」罪名，違反《刑事罪行條例》。案件訂於星期一在東區裁判法院提堂。
廉署表示，被告於2020年12月至2024年12月期間，涉嫌在證監會內部系統進行12次未經授權搜查，對象涉及10名人士及商業實體。事發時她隸屬企業失當行為組，主要負責調查上市公司涉嫌欺詐行為，惟該等搜查均與她負責的個案無關。
廉署與證監會曾進行聯合調查，被告其後遭證監會解僱。相關貪污調查仍在進行中。
